name: tollwire
description: TollWire adds a policy enforcement layer to AI coding agents: it checks file writes, shell commands and new dependencies before they run, blocks detected violations, and keeps a tamper-evident log of reported changes, scans and approvals as evidence supporting ISO 27001 and NIS2 audits. TollWire itself runs locally and sends no data anywhere.

plugins.name: tollwire-guardrail
plugins.description: Blocks writes to protected paths, dangerous shell commands and non-allowlisted dependencies; exposes the same checks as MCP tools.

plugins.name: tollwire-evidence
plugins.description: Tamper-evident evidence log for reported agent changes, scans and approvals, mapped to ISO 27001 / NIS2 controls (draft mapping).
